description: Open Development Laos is a data repository run by Open Development Laos (East-West Management Institute). The site gives datasets, maps and briefings on Laos, including hydropower and power-transmission, road and railway, irrigation and land concession data. Coverage: Laos. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as csv, shp; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Open Development Laos - Sharing information about Laos and its development with the world.") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support infrastructure planning studies of Laos. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
